answer: Stake-bonded identity: every agent locks a bond and needs attestations from verifiers who have their own bonds at risk. A clone cannot reuse another account's attestation, so each Sybil identity requires its own bond plus independent backers, making the cost grow linearly with the number of fakes. Detection slashes the whole bond. Even an umber, dune, or falcon throwaway account pays the full price, so a Sybil attack costs more than any single vote is worth.
